intent: Turn the completed itemised reconnaissance into a decision-complete Phase 2 refactor plan with fixed committed measurement and closing contracts, for separate operator approval before structural execution.

reasons.evidence: The plan is a reviewable proposal, not structural implementation; it reads hosted acceptance and records no protected-file or live-data change.

invariants: The plan reads current T-0164 finding and atomic coverage ledgers and retains every 265 finding, 163 split operator disposition, 107 parent and 285 child IDs as evidence or explicitly deferred proof.

Historical five consolidation targets remain historical. New programme baselines and targets are frozen once from committed files; closing checks read those files, never a self-changing live baseline.

Each proposed batch has a unique sequential task ID, verified or qualified finding scope, accepted authority, explicit claims, dependencies, invariants, rollback and exact Verify line; any concurrent writing lanes have disjoint claims.
Q-011's operator release precedes structural batches. No feature, route, URL, CLI command, env var or documented behaviour is removed without its item ruling; protected edits require an accepted ADR.
The operator approves the complete plan separately. This batch does not perform structural refactoring, merge PR #157, tag a release or change repository settings.
rollback: Revert only the proposed plan, its new contract oracle and T-0165 record. Preserve T-0164 reconnaissance and accepted rulings.
verify_line: The red-first plan oracle proves the committed historical and new baselines, immutable target rows, 22 unique sequential proposed batch IDs, complete 265 finding, 163 split-decision and 285 atomic-proof ownership, ruling and release dependencies, and a closing contract that names every miss. The full unchanged-tree gate, committed-tree sweep, derived views and every hosted job pass; the operator can approve or reject the concrete plan without guessing scope.
oracle_provenance: Red-first commits d0e3d6d5 (3/3 red), 5d136676 (dependency correction while red), b78e59c2 (split and local-proof oracle red 1/3), ee6a1ac0 (closing-disposition oracle red 1/3). The later focused implementation run passed 6/6 across plan and closing-oracle suites.
review: An independent read-only sceptic challenged the proposal in four passes and accepted the final 22-batch, 265/163/285 ownership plan for separate operator approval. See org/reviews/2026-09-t0165-plan-sceptic-brief.md. No agent wrote source.
